new file mode 100644
index 000000000..08ae326fd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/setup_module_discovery.py
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+"""Discovery of top-level module names in a distribution, including setup modules."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+import os
+
+
+def setup_module_discovery(package_files: Iterable[str]) -> Iterator[str]:
+    """Given an iterable of file names in a source distribution, return the top-level
+    module and package names it provides, including a root-level ``setup.py`` module.
+
+    This is meant for packaging diagnostics, and follows the same rules as
+    :func:`_pytest.config._iter_rewritable_modules`, except that a ``setup.py`` at the
+    root of the distribution is reported as the ``setup`` module instead of being
+    ignored. Editable installation finder modules made by setuptools are still ignored.
+
+    For example, for an egg based distribution with these file names:
+
+        src/pytest_mock/__init__.py
+        src/pytest_mock/plugin.py
+        src/pytest_mock.egg-info/PKG-INFO
+        LICENSE
+        setup.py
+
+    the names ``setup`` and ``pytest_mock`` are returned.
+    """
+    package_files = list(package_files)
+    seen_some = False
+    for fn in package_files:
+        is_simple_module = "/" not in fn and fn.endswith(".py")
+        is_package = fn.count("/") == 1 and fn.endswith("__init__.py")
+        if is_simple_module:
+            module_name, _ = os.path.splitext(fn)
+            # We ignore editable installation finder modules made by setuptools.
+            if not module_name.startswith("__editable__"):
+                seen_some = True
+                yield module_name
+        elif is_package:
+            package_name = os.path.dirname(fn)
+            seen_some = True
+            yield package_name
+
+    if not seen_some:
+        # At this point we did not find any packages or modules, so we try again by
+        # stripping the first path component (to account for "src" based source trees
+        # for example).
+        new_package_files = []
+        for fn in package_files:
+            parts = fn.split("/")
+            new_fn = "/".join(parts[1:])
+            if new_fn:
+                new_package_files.append(new_fn)
+        if new_package_files:
+            yield from setup_module_discovery(new_package_files)
diff --git a/testing/test_setup_module_discovery.py b/testing/test_setup_module_discovery.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..ddccf3a4a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_setup_module_discovery.py
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest.config import _iter_rewritable_modules
+from _pytest.setup_module_discovery import setup_module_discovery
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "names, expected",
+    [
+        ([], []),
+        (["bar.py"], ["bar"]),
+        (["foo/bar.py"], ["bar"]),
+        (["foo/bar.pyc"], []),
+        (["foo/__init__.py"], ["foo"]),
+        (["bar/__init__.py", "xz.py"], ["bar", "xz"]),
+        (["setup.py"], ["setup"]),
+        (["bar/__init__.py", "setup.py"], ["bar", "setup"]),
+        # egg based distributions root contain the files from the dist root
+        (["src/bar/__init__.py"], ["bar"]),
+        (["src/bar/__init__.py", "setup.py"], ["setup"]),
+        (["source/python/bar/__init__.py", "setup.py"], ["setup"]),
+        (["source/python/bar/__init__.py", "LICENSE"], ["bar"]),
+        (["src/setup.py"], ["setup"]),
+        # editable installation finder modules
+        (["__editable___xyz_finder.py"], []),
+        (["bar/__init__.py", "__editable___xyz_finder.py"], ["bar"]),
+        (["setup.py", "__editable___xyz_finder.py"], ["setup"]),
+    ],
+)
+def test_setup_module_discovery(names: list[str], expected: list[str]) -> None:
+    assert list(setup_module_discovery(names)) == expected
+
+
+def test_setup_module_discovery_accepts_iterator() -> None:
+    names = iter(["src/bar/__init__.py", "src/baz.py"])
+    assert list(setup_module_discovery(names)) == ["bar", "baz"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "names",
+    [
+        [],
+        ["bar.py", "foo/__init__.py"],
+        ["src/bar/__init__.py", "LICENSE"],
+        ["__editable___xyz_finder.py", "a/b/c/__init__.py"],
+    ],
+)
+def test_matches_iter_rewritable_modules_without_setup(names: list[str]) -> None:
+    assert list(setup_module_discovery(names)) == list(_iter_rewritable_modules(names))
+
+
+def test_invalid_input_raises_like_iter_rewritable_modules() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        list(_iter_rewritable_modules(None))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        list(setup_module_discovery(None))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
